content:
Apple has released public beta 2 for iPadOS 27.3 alongside a variety of other 27.3 updates. Here’s what’s new.

Apple rolls out public beta 2 for iPadOS 27.3 and more

Public beta testers, Apple is rolling out new updates to its 27.3 software versions today.

iPadOS 27.3 public beta 2 is now available for testing, plus new betas for watchOS and more.

If you’re new to Apple’s beta software, you can join the public beta program for free at beta.apple.com.

Today’s beta 2 releases are mostly the same as the builds that first debuted earlier this week for developers. They include new features such as:

  • Video podcasts debuting in the Apple TV app
  • Siri AI adding support for health data
  • Apple Calendar getting design updates
  • tvOS introducing Siri AI for beta users (it first debuted to the public in tvOS 27.2.1)

Some of the more noteworthy changes, however, are exclusive to iPhone Duo in iOS 27.3. The Duo now offers a face unlock feature and a new setting that locks the device when you close it.

If you’re not willing to risk installing beta software on your devices, Apple is expected to launch its 27.3 wave of updates to all users in mid-December.

Have you installed iPadOS 27.3 public beta 2 or another update? Let us know of anything new you find via the comments.
